robot.vision.snapshot:1.name: robot.vision.snapshot
robot.vision.snapshot:1.description: One coherent retained frame, pose and map revision; image bytes are opt-in.

robot.vision.frame:1.name: robot.vision.frame
robot.vision.frame:1.description: An exact retained frame as verified artifact chunks, with capture metadata.

robot.vision.detections:1.name: robot.vision.detections
robot.vision.detections:1.description: Current-frame detections and tracker-epoch identities with quality and freshness.

robot.vision.geometry:1.name: robot.vision.geometry
robot.vision.geometry:1.description: Localization and spatial evidence with explicit availability, quality and unknown coverage.

robot.vision.metadata:1.name: robot.vision.metadata
robot.vision.metadata:1.description: Source, calibration, implementation and coordinate metadata.

robot.vision.status:1.name: robot.vision.status
robot.vision.status:1.description: Camera, transport, decoding, inference and provider health.

robot.map.read:1.name: robot.map.read
robot.map.read:1.description: A bounded map page; bounds uses min_x,min_y,max_x,max_y and optional min_z,max_z in map units.

robot.map.changes:1.name: robot.map.changes
robot.map.changes:1.description: Persistent changes between explicit map revisions.

robot.map.checkpoint:1.name: robot.map.checkpoint
robot.map.checkpoint:1.description: Flush the persistent map and return its durable checkpoint identity.

robot.map.create:1.name: robot.map.create
robot.map.create:1.description: Create a new map identity; this does not establish localization or metric scale.

robot.map.open:1.name: robot.map.open
robot.map.open:1.description: Select an existing persistent map; localization must be re-established.

robot.vision.calibration:1.name: robot.vision.calibration
robot.vision.calibration:1.description: Get or set calibration. action is get or set; unverified geometry remains explicit.

robot.vision.project_ground:1.name: robot.vision.project_ground
robot.vision.project_ground:1.description: Intersect an individually confirmed floor pixel with the calibrated ground plane.
